verification.note: frontend/e2e-components/fixtures/app.tsx:78-80 statically imports ../../src/addons/intelligence/AskTab, askStore and messages/en.json. That one fixture is the entry for every e2e-components spec (build-bundle.ts:19-22, root FIXTURE_DIR). frontend/src/addons/ is gitignored (.gitignore:33) and only setup-addons.sh creates it (setup-addons.sh:5,19,50,173). So when the link tree is missing, the vite build fails for the whole suite. docs/developer-guide/testing.md:198-213 ('Components in a browser') still describes only `pnpm test:e2e:components` and does not name setup-addons.sh. The other testing.md references are at :117, :141 and :330 and cover vitest. One part of the claim is wrong: build-bundle.ts:28-32 was not left stale. The comment now goes on to say 'The Ask-thread case imports one addon file by a relative path on purpose', so it records the exception, although it still conflicts with the principle stated just before it.

Same evidence as R1. app.tsx:78-80 makes hard relative imports into the gitignored link tree (.gitignore:33). setup-addons.sh:5,173 creates that tree as per-file symlinks. The single fixture bundle (build-bundle.ts:19-56) is shared by every spec under e2e-components/, so a checkout without submodules or without setup-addons.sh cannot build any of them. testing.md:198-213 does not name the prerequisite. The build-bundle.ts comment at :28-32 has been extended to acknowledge the Ask-thread exception, so the claim is right that the comment still states the general rule, but it is no longer silent about the exception.

At this commit, .github/workflows/ci.yml:306-313 checks out with `submodules: recursive` and runs ./setup-addons.sh at job level. The earlier comment justifying a run without addons is gone, and the job's only other comment (:296-298) is about e2e/. The same job runs `pnpm test:e2e:layout` (:344-346). e2e-layout/build-fixture-css.ts:4-7 states that `@source "../addons"` (globals.css:10) is skipped silently when the link tree is absent, so with the tree present the compiled layout sheet now includes the addon sources at the pinned commits. The components bundle reuses the same buildFixtureCss (build-bundle.ts:17), so both suites measure one sheet. I confirmed the facts only. Whether this matters depends on whether an addon class affects a rule the layout fixtures measure, and I did not check that.
